name: Aeon Balloon
description: Upon use, immediately recovers 3 Technique Points for the team.
story:
Among all the themed balloons sold at the seaside park, Aeon balloons are by far the best-sellers. And within that category, the Nihility, Abundance, Propagation, and Preservation Path balloons top the charts. Some eccentric Aeon scholars believe this reflects a collective unconscious foretelling the cosmic future. Consumer surveys, however, tell a different story: people buy them because "keeping one at home brings blessings in that particular domain."

"I heard that releasing a certain number of balloons grants you the power of the corresponding Aeon's Path..."
"First of all, that's called littering. Second, drop those 50 Propagation balloons RIGHT NOW!"
